flowRoot.flowPara: TIP: This is your Ultimate skill. It can be used at any time, but only once per encounter. Choose the timing carefully to maximize its impact.
TIP: This is your Recovery skill. It can restore a lot of health, but only two total Recovery abilities can be used by your entire group in each encounter.
Quick Rules Primer:
Actions
• You get 3 actions per turn. They can be used as Skill,
Move or Focus actions. You can't use the same type of
action more than twice per turn.
• Skill Action: Use any skill.
• Move Action: Move your speed, or use a skill with the
Maneuver keyword.
• Focus Action: Recharge a skill or draw a card.
Cards
• Draw one at the start of each turn.
• Weaving: You may discard a card to add its power value to any individual strike, heal or shield.
• Heroic: You may discard two cards that match the symbols on a standard skill card to use the Heroic version of that skill instead.
Movement
• Normal movement is blocked by walls, pillars and enemy units. Shifting allows you to move through enemy units.
• Moving or shifting into a rough terrain square costs 2 squares of movement.
Bloodlust Ultimate • Self
Choose a foe. This turn, whenever you strike that foe, you strike that foe again for the same amount of damage. In addition, you gain the Active benefits from your inactive pacts this turn.
Violent Transfusion
Target foe loses 4 health. You gain 2 health for every health you've caused that foe to lose this turn.
You may play Violent Transfusion for free if you just activated a Pact.
• Melee
Statistics
Health: 40
Actions: 3
Speed: 3
Hand: 3
